bio.text: Ryan Fazio has been a Republican state senator for Connecticut's 36th District, covering Greenwich and parts of Stamford and New Canaan, since winning a special election in August 2021.
He is the Republican nominee for governor in 2026 and also appears on the Independent Party line.

According to his campaign website, he was born in Norwalk, raised in Greenwich, earned an economics degree from Northwestern University, and worked in energy, agriculture and shipping before entering public service.

sources.title: Connecticut's November Races Come Into Focus as Fazio Nominated by GOP to Challenge Lamont
